description: This file contains the main entry point and core UI components for a Flutter-based QR code scanner app. It includes theme setup, the main app widget, camera scanner integration, history management, and navigation.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget setting up MaterialApp with custom theme.

classes.name: QrHistoryProvider
classes.description: ChangeNotifier class managing in-memory QR code scan history.

classes.name: MainScreen
classes.description: StatefulWidget managing camera, scan, and results display.

classes.name: _AppDrawer
classes.description: Drawer widget for navigation and options.

classes.name: _QrResultArea
classes.description: Widget displaying scan result with options to copy or open URL.

classes.name: HistoryScreen
classes.description: Displays list of previous scan results.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point, initializes the app and sets up the provider.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build methods for widgets, constructing their UI.

methods.name: _launchUrl
methods.description: Attempts to open a URL using the device's browser.

methods.name: _copyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies provided text to clipboard and shows user feedback.

methods.name: _onDetect
methods.description: Handles QR code detection from the camera feed.

methods.name: _openHistory
methods.description: Navigates to the scan history screen.
